name: Magic Connoisseur

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell from your Magic Initiate list, using its casting ability. Both are always prepared; cast each free once per Long Rest or using slots. Replace one with a same-level spell from that list on gaining a level.
